baseline.observed: Check Point discovery job d7fa18f7-79a4-4da1-8254-e224ef4a7f75 enumerated 5 domains successfully but failed during queryObjects with ManagementPlaneQueryFailedException. CpObjectDumpParser truncates quoted strings with parentheses at the first ')' and discards object names after '(', causing parse failure or missing DISPLAY_NAME.
baseline.what_exists: CpObjectDumpParser.readLeafValue does 'while (peek() != ")")' which truncates quoted comments/descriptions containing parentheses. In parseObject, readToken() reads the object name after '(' but discards it instead of putting it into fields.putIfAbsent("name", name). ManagementPlaneQueryFailedException has writableStackTrace=false suppressing stack traces.

invariants: Opaque identity handling: stable identifiers preserved

requirements: In CpObjectDumpParser.java: 1) update readLeafValue() to check if value starts with quote '"'; if so, read until closing '"' (handling escaped '\"') before closing ')'; if not quoted, track paren depth so balanced parens are handled. 2) In parseObject(), read the object name (quoted or unquoted) and do fields.putIfAbsent("name", objectName) so if :name is absent from object body, DISPLAY_NAME is populated. 3) In expect(char), provide diagnostic detail in ManagementPlaneQueryFailedException with expected char, actual char, and position.
In ManagementPlaneQueryFailedException.java: enable stack traces with super(message, cause, true, true) and add constructors taking detail message and cause.
In ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter.java: update LOGGER.log to log the caught exception with full stack trace.
In CpObjectDumpParserTest.java: add tests verifying quoted strings with parentheses (e.g. :comments ("Created (HA active)")) and objects without explicit :name attribute.
Run ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 :worker:test to verify all tests pass.
